AttributeList.Text: Control area-Main (C-109): every cross-instance fact in the project lives here (C-127) - buffer-to-instance input wiring, the sequencer/motor/pusher calls in dependency order (sequencer decides, motor and pusher obey within the same scan), inter-instance command wiring, and the buffer output map. No working logic beyond wiring, with two documented extras (C-606): the In_Cycle lamp OR (owner ruling 2026-07-16, REQ-069 - field feedbacks, not commands) and the soft-start fault-reset pass-through to DQ11 (panel provides the output; Q-14 records the open control-on question).

InHand, InhibitMotor, and HandReverse are deliberate constants (C-604): unrequested imported-FB capability (hand mode, external inhibit, hand-reverse) carried disabled - design, not placeholder debt. RecentStart is armed, never driven: the sequencer's MotorStartArm (PreStart step only) ORs into the FB's own bit, and the FB's self-clear (once running or faulted - its N4 'set on start press' contract) is the only clearer, so one fresh start press arms exactly one start attempt and an E-stop or fault can never auto-restart the motor (REQ-062; replaces the RecentStart := AlwaysTrue strap that defeated the FB's semantics).

In_Cycle lamp definition (owner ruling, 2026-07-16): on whenever any piece of equipment is running - taken from field running feedbacks (shredder fwd/rev, discharge conveyor, infeed conveyor, pusher power pack), not PLC run commands, so the lamp reflects what the machine is actually doing. This also gives Infeed_Conv_Running its consumer. iDB_ShredderSequencer.IO.InCycle is superseded by this rung and no longer wired; removing the member is deferred to the queued settings-rework request (interface change).

Integration of the hopper-blockage supervisor (S6 request #1). Appended after the output map to keep NETWORK 1-7 byte-identical (S7 invariance discipline); functionally safe - this FB's outputs feed only FC_AlarmsMain's annunciation, never NETWORK 7's buffer output map, so its scan position relative to NETWORK 7 is immaterial. PlantRunning is the confirmed shredder-running feedback, either direction (REQ-069 honesty - field feedback, not command). The FB's HopperBlockedInhibit stop demand is deliberately left unwired for now (owner scope call - alarm-only integration).
